data.long_meaning: From the Old German words ‘holz’ meaning ‘wood’ and ‘mann’ meaning ‘man’. This name is of German origin and translates to ‘man of the woods’. In a Christian context, it can symbolize living in harmony with nature and God. The name Holzman carries the meaning “Man of the woods” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Holzman usually hope their child will grow to embody man of the woods and live with faith, good character and purpose.
